title: Representing the Under-Represented: Cultural and Core Capability Benchmarks for Developing Thai Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to culturally sensitive questions using the ThaiCLI benchmark, which provides chosen and rejected answers. An external LLM (LLM-as-a-Judge) scores the generated answers based on their alignment with Thai cultural norms, values, and ethical standards across domains such as religion, politics, and the royal family.
